$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: Social Analyzer - Find Social Media by Username | Sherlock
seoDescription: Find someone's social media profiles from a username, across 900+ sites. Confidence-ranked, no login or API key. Paste a handle or link, we clean it. For recruiting, fraud checks, people search.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Full-depth default runs 8 scanner processes at once; on the platform they peaked at 2046 MB of a 2 GB run and two steps were OOM-killed (exit -9), losing 250 sites (build 1.0.8 test run, 2026-09-12: 175 s, 206 profiles vs 289 locally). 4 GB gives ~2 GB headroom and a full vCPU. Compute per full run at 4 GB is about 0.2 CU ($0.04) against ~200 charged rows ($0.80 developer share). Timeout 3600 matches the input's one-hour maximum.

pricing.$comment: v1.1.0 moves charging from apify-default-dataset-item ($0.005 per row incl. the summary) to a custom 'profile' event at the same $0.005, charged per step as rows are delivered; the summary row becomes free. Applied via API on 2026-09-12: the platform refused an immediate start (cannot-modify-actor-pricing-with-immediate-effect: a public Actor with users needs notice), so the record is scheduled to start 2026-09-26T22:14Z. Until then rows are still charged per dataset item by the platform and the code's 'profile' charges log a harmless unknown-event warning. The CI script will report the future record until it starts, then 'live prices match'. Event name must equal PROFILE_EVENT in src/main.py. Store discounts chosen by the owner on 2026-10-29 (Gentle ladder): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less. Bulk buyers sit on Scale and Business (Aug-Oct revenue by tier), and the Console quality score asks for Store discounts. Deepening is immediate; undoing is an increase (14 days' notice). Review revenue by tier in mid-November. Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

profile.eventDescription: One profile row: platform, URL, confidence, match rate, site category and country, page title, language and meta tags. Charged as each step of the scan delivers its rows. The summary row is free.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
